ex.en: This is Unit 1 of our English book.
ex.zh: 这是我们英语书的第一单元。

ex.en: In which unit of a textbook can the text be found?
ex.zh: 这篇短文可以在课本的哪个单元找到？

ex.en: Starter Unit 1 is about how to greet people.
ex.zh: 过渡单元 1 讲的是如何跟人打招呼。

ex.en: Before Unit 1, the starter units help new students review what they learned in primary school.
ex.zh: 在第一单元之前，过渡单元帮助新生复习小学学过的内容。

ex.en: Read the conversation in Section B.
ex.zh: 读一读 B 部分的对话。

ex.en: This section of the library is only for students who are reading quietly.
ex.zh: 图书馆的这个区域只供安静阅读的学生使用。

ex.en: How do you greet people?
ex.zh: 你怎样跟人打招呼？

ex.en: As I entered the house, Mom greeted me with a smile.
ex.zh: 我一进家门，妈妈就笑着跟我打招呼。

ex.en: Oh, I have drum class on Tuesday afternoons.
ex.zh: 哦，我周二下午有鼓课。

ex.en: Oh, I forgot to bring my homework, so I had to go back home to get it.
ex.zh: 哦，我忘了带作业，只好回家去拿。

ex.en: Everyone in our class likes her.
ex.zh: 我们班每个人都喜欢她。

ex.en: This is a wonderful story everyone should know.
ex.zh: 这是一个人人都应该知道的精彩故事。

ex.en: It's a special way to start the week.
ex.zh: 这是开始新一周的一种特别方式。

ex.en: Chinese New Year starts with a spring-cleaning day called Sao Chen.
ex.zh: 春节从一个叫“扫尘”的大扫除日开始。

ex.en: Listen to three conversations and colour the things.
ex.zh: 听三段对话，给物品涂上颜色。

ex.en: One evening, I overheard her conversation with an elderly lady.
ex.zh: 一天傍晚，我无意中听到了她和一位老太太的谈话。

ex.en: How do you spell your name?
ex.zh: 你的名字怎么拼写？

ex.en: Why don't you come to Spelling Bee Day?
ex.zh: 你为什么不来参加拼字比赛日呢？

ex.en: Oh, that's the bell. Let's go to class.
ex.zh: 哦，铃响了。我们去上课吧。

ex.en: Its bells ring every hour, and at night, it is beautifully lit up.
ex.zh: 它的钟每小时响一次，到了晚上灯火辉煌，非常漂亮。

ex.en: I have a bottle.
ex.zh: 我有一个瓶子。

ex.en: Although the bottles can be recycled, only a small part of them are.
ex.zh: 虽然这些瓶子可以回收，但真正被回收的只有一小部分。

ex.en: I have an eraser.
ex.zh: 我有一块橡皮。

ex.en: She lent me her eraser when I made a mistake in the exam.
ex.zh: 考试时我写错了，她把橡皮借给了我。

ex.en: Are your keys in the box?
ex.zh: 你的钥匙在盒子里吗？

ex.en: According to the teacher, what is the key to practicing dance well?
ex.zh: 根据老师的说法，练好舞蹈的关键是什么？

ex.en: We put our things in the desk drawers.
ex.zh: 我们把东西放在课桌抽屉里。

ex.en: Try to find out how living things grow around you.
ex.zh: 试着去发现你身边的生物是怎样生长的。

ex.en: —Thank you. —You're welcome.
ex.zh: ——谢谢你。——不客气。

ex.en: —Thank you for your advice. —You're welcome.
ex.zh: ——谢谢你的建议。——不客气。

ex.en: I learn a lot at my school and have fun too.
ex.zh: 我在学校学到很多，也玩得很开心。

ex.en: The best way to tidy up is to make it fun.
ex.zh: 整理房间最好的方法就是让它变得有趣。

ex.en: What animal does Helen see in the yard?
ex.zh: 海伦在院子里看到了什么动物？

ex.en: In the large yard stood thirteen trees of different sizes.
ex.zh: 大院子里立着十三棵大小不一的树。

ex.en: They are carrot plants.
ex.zh: 它们是胡萝卜苗。

ex.en: Grandpa grows carrots, tomatoes and potatoes in his garden every spring.
ex.zh: 每年春天，爷爷都在菜园里种胡萝卜、西红柿和土豆。

ex.en: Is that a goose?
ex.zh: 那是一只鹅吗？

ex.en: A goose walked slowly across the farm, followed by its babies.
ex.zh: 一只鹅慢慢地走过农场，小鹅们跟在它后面。

ex.en: Let me count. One, two, three, four, five…
ex.zh: 让我数一数。一、二、三、四、五……

ex.en: A certain kind of ants can count their steps to avoid getting lost.
ex.zh: 有一种蚂蚁能数自己走了多少步，以免迷路。

ex.en: Oh, and there's another blackboard at the back of the classroom.
ex.zh: 哦，教室后面还有一块黑板。

ex.en: A moment later, the squirrel climbed down to the ground to pick another pecan.
ex.zh: 过了一会儿，松鼠爬下树，又去捡了一颗山核桃。

ex.en: What else can you see on the farm?
ex.zh: 你在农场上还能看到什么？

ex.en: I looked around, but nobody else seemed to have noticed it.
ex.zh: 我环顾四周，但似乎没有别人注意到它。

ex.en: Circle the words you hear.
ex.zh: 圈出你听到的单词。

ex.en: Over and over, I carefully cleaned a small circle on my window so that I could see the rain outside.
ex.zh: 我一遍又一遍地把窗户擦出一个小圆圈，好看清外面的雨。

ex.en: It's fun to look at the marks later.
ex.zh: 以后再看这些记号很有意思。

ex.zh: 如果你观察海里的鱼，可能会看到鲜艳多彩的花纹。

ex.en: Do you like to make new friends at school?
ex.zh: 你喜欢在学校交新朋友吗？

ex.en: His job was to make friends with some tribes and bring peace to the area.
ex.zh: 他的任务是和一些部落交朋友，给这个地区带来和平。

ex.en: How do we get to know each other?
ex.zh: 我们怎样相互认识？

ex.en: We hope people will get to know more about my hometown.
ex.zh: 我们希望人们能更多地了解我的家乡。

ex.en: Each boat has one teacher and one class.
ex.zh: 每条船上有一位老师和一个班。

ex.en: Each living thing has its own pattern as it grows.
ex.zh: 每种生物在生长中都有自己的规律。

ex.zh: 你今天还有什么别的课？

ex.en: Pilots, farmers and many other people depend on these forecasts.
ex.zh: 飞行员、农民和许多其他人都依靠这些天气预报。

ex.en: We love and help each other.
ex.zh: 我们彼此相爱，互相帮助。

ex.en: Most importantly, the Silk Road helped different cultures learn from each other.
ex.zh: 最重要的是，丝绸之路帮助不同的文化相互学习。

ex.en: His full name is George Charles Wood.
ex.zh: 他的全名是乔治·查尔斯·伍德。

ex.en: It seems as if the world is full of patterns.
ex.zh: 这个世界似乎充满了各种规律。

ex.en: My full name is Alan Luke Wood.
ex.zh: 我的全名是艾伦·卢克·伍德。

ex.en: —What's his full name? —His full name is Jim Green.
ex.zh: ——他的全名叫什么？——他的全名是吉姆·格林。

ex.en: I'm in Class 1, Grade 7.
ex.zh: 我在七年级一班。

ex.en: She had been trying hard to forget about starting third grade in a new town.
ex.zh: 她一直努力不去想要在一个新城镇开始读三年级的事。

ex.en: We also call the last name a "family name" or "surname".
ex.zh: 我们也把姓称为“家族名”或“姓氏”。

ex.en: In China, people put their last name before their first name.
ex.zh: 在中国，人们把姓放在名字前面。

ex.en: This is my new classmate.
ex.zh: 这是我的新同学。

ex.zh: 为什么阿南娅的同学们都躲着她？

ex.zh: 你的班主任是谁？

ex.en: Our class teacher always encourages us to ask questions when we don't understand.
ex.zh: 我们班主任总是鼓励我们不懂就问。

ex.en: Alan is my first name, Luke is my middle name, and Wood is my last name.
ex.zh: 艾伦是我的名，卢克是我的中间名，伍德是我的姓。

ex.en: In English names, the first name usually comes before the family name.
ex.zh: 在英文名字里，名通常放在姓的前面。

ex.en: Don't worry. Everyone makes mistakes.
ex.zh: 别担心，每个人都会犯错。

ex.en: I can learn a lot from others, even from the mistakes.
ex.zh: 我可以从别人身上学到很多，甚至从错误中学习。

ex.en: China is a big country.
ex.zh: 中国是一个大国。

ex.en: It also spread to other countries, changing the way people learned and communicated.
ex.zh: 它还传到了其他国家，改变了人们学习和交流的方式。

ex.en: Wow, we're in the same class!
ex.zh: 哇，我们在同一个班！

ex.en: They can get some exercise, enjoy the fresh air and be happy, all at the same time.
ex.zh: 他们可以同时锻炼身体、享受新鲜空气，还能心情愉快。

ex.zh: 埃玛和埃拉是双胞胎。

ex.zh: 虽然是双胞胎，这对姐妹的爱好却很不一样。

ex.en: I like hot pot very much.
ex.zh: 我非常喜欢火锅。

ex.en: My sister copied me, threw another pot over her shoulder and carried it.
ex.zh: 我妹妹学着我的样子，把另一口锅甩到肩上扛着。

ex.en: Her favourite food is Mapo tofu.
ex.zh: 她最喜欢的食物是麻婆豆腐。

ex.en: Tofu is made from beans, and it is popular all over China.
ex.zh: 豆腐是用豆子做的，在全中国都很受欢迎。

ex.en: I need a pair of sports shoes for school.
ex.zh: 我上学需要一双运动鞋。

ex.en: Like people, animals need to rest after working hard.
ex.zh: 和人一样，动物在辛苦劳动后也需要休息。

ex.en: It's a parrot.
ex.zh: 它是一只鹦鹉。

ex.en: The parrot can say "Hello" to everyone who comes into the shop.
ex.zh: 这只鹦鹉会向每一个进店的人说“你好”。

ex.en: I like music, and I play the guitar.
ex.zh: 我喜欢音乐，还会弹吉他。

ex.en: What made Dora fall in love with the guitar?
ex.zh: 是什么让多拉爱上了吉他？

ex.en: He often plays tennis with me.
ex.zh: 他经常和我打网球。

ex.en: She was deeply attracted by a tennis match.
ex.zh: 她被一场网球比赛深深吸引住了。

ex.en: I can play the guitar.
ex.zh: 我会弹吉他。

senses.zh: 想（用于礼貌地邀请或向某人提供某物）；将会

ex.zh: 你愿意做我的朋友吗？

ex.zh: 你想让男生还是女生做你的搭档？

ex.zh: 我想学法语。

ex.zh: 事由：我们的学校旅行——请阅读邮件，并在周五前回复。

ex.en: I'm from London, in the UK.
ex.zh: 我来自英国伦敦。

ex.zh: 她最喜欢的食物是麻婆豆腐。

ex.zh: 放学后，我们常在体育馆打半小时乒乓球。

ex.zh: 我们很不一样，但在一起玩得很开心。

ex.zh: 詹妮弗请索菲娅和她坐在一起时，感觉怎么样？

ex.zh: 我们大部分时间待在教室里。

ex.en: Later, she gave birth to a baby son called Chen Xiang.
ex.zh: 后来，她生下了一个儿子，名叫沉香。

ex.en: I often listen to the news or music.
ex.zh: 我经常听新闻或音乐。

ex.en: For example, listen to your favorite song, or watch an interesting TV program.
ex.zh: 比如，听听你最喜欢的歌，或者看一个有趣的电视节目。

ex.en: There's a large sports field next to the teachers' building.
ex.zh: 教师楼旁边有一个大运动场。

ex.en: Why did Mia sit down next to the writer?
ex.zh: 米娅为什么坐到了作者旁边？

ex.en: Hi, I'm Lily from Ireland.
ex.zh: 你好，我是来自爱尔兰的莉莉。

ex.en: Ireland is an island country with green fields and friendly people.
ex.zh: 爱尔兰是一个岛国，有绿色的田野和友好的人们。

ex.en: There is a teachers' building across from the school hall.
ex.zh: 礼堂对面有一栋教师楼。

ex.en: Every Friday afternoon, they hold small shows and exhibitions in the school hall.
ex.zh: 每周五下午，他们在学校礼堂举办小型演出和展览。

ex.en: The dining hall is across from the sports field.
ex.zh: 餐厅在运动场对面。

ex.en: How could she face so many strangers in the dining hall?
ex.zh: 她怎么能面对餐厅里那么多陌生人呢？

ex.en: There are some trees in front of the sports field.
ex.zh: 运动场前面有一些树。

ex.en: Many students are spending too much time in front of screens, especially during online classes.
ex.zh: 很多学生在屏幕前花的时间太多了，上网课时尤其如此。

ex.en: There are many modern buildings.
ex.zh: 有许多现代化的建筑。

ex.en: If you photograph a building from a plane, it looks tiny.
ex.zh: 如果从飞机上拍一栋楼，它看起来很小。

ex.en: There is a big table in the middle of the classroom.
ex.zh: 教室中间有一张大桌子。

ex.en: This ancient city is in the middle of Henan, with mountains and rivers all around.
ex.zh: 这座古城位于河南中部，四周群山环绕、河流纵横。

ex.en: The teachers' building is across from the school hall.
ex.zh: 教师楼在礼堂对面。

ex.en: The Silk Road became a busy highway for traders who carried things across deserts and mountains.
ex.zh: 丝绸之路成了商人们翻越沙漠和高山运送货物的繁忙大道。

ex.en: There is a teachers' building across from the school hall.
ex.zh: 礼堂对面有一栋教师楼。

ex.en: The new library is across from the dining hall, so it's easy to find.
ex.zh: 新图书馆在餐厅对面，很好找。

ex.en: There is a student centre between the library and the gym.
ex.zh: 图书馆和体育馆之间有一个学生中心。

ex.en: Join the Summer Action at the Health Centre right now.
ex.zh: 现在就来健康中心参加“夏日行动”吧。
